text: The 5 bill-to customers with the highest revenue including tax in calendar 2015.
interpretation: The 5 bill-to customers with the highest revenue including tax in calendar 2015 (Bill-To role; the source has 3 bill-to customers).
assemble: SELECT bill_to_customer, revenue_including_tax FROM q WHERE lines > 0 ORDER BY revenue_including_tax DESC, bill_to_customer LIMIT 5
